searchText: For Besu, if we drop pre-merge blocks you should expect to save ~490 GiB. Slightly less if headers are retained. For reference I believe the pre-merge era1 file is ~450 GiB Amazing. 490 GiB or so gives us at least a year of leeway. Potentially time enough to get full 4444 working by May 2026 Or at least more history expiry to kick the can further down the road 🙂 <@543900561460822016> I believe you are the author of all of the relevant EIPs. Which EIP should we use for this? What can I do to help get it updated to reflect the current plan?
